This budget is to enable voluntary and community groups (Non Commercial) to apply for funding for projects/events, that will both benefit and enable the community and its residents. If you are interested in joining you local Neighbourhood Board, or your community group is interested in nominating a representative, download an Board membership application form . Chaddesden Neighbourhood Forum Neighbourhood forums take place in the ward if there is an issue that needs a meeting. When a Neighbourhood Forum is required it will be advertised.
